title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 24
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 24: David counts the people, chooses a punishment and buys the threshing floor of Araunah.

questions.text: Whom did the king send to count the people from Dan to Beersheba?
questions.explanation: The king told Joab, the captain of the army, to go through all the tribes of Israel from Dan to Beersheba and count the people.

questions.text: What did Joab ask the king about the counting?
questions.explanation: Joab wished that Yahweh would add to the people a hundred times, but asked why the king delighted in this thing.

answers.text: Why the king delighted in this thing
How many soldiers he should take along
Whether the Levites should be counted too
How much silver the census would cost

questions.text: How long did the counting take before they came back to Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: After going through all the land, they came to Jerusalem at the end of nine months and twenty days.

questions.text: How many men of Judah were counted?
questions.explanation: Joab reported eight hundred thousand valiant men in Israel, and the men of Judah were five hundred thousand men.

questions.text: What did David say to Yahweh after his heart struck him?
questions.explanation: David's heart struck him after he counted the people, and he said, "I have sinned greatly in that which I have done."

answers.text: "I have sinned greatly in that which I have done"
"The people are now ready for war"
"Let the count be written in the book"

questions.text: Who brought Yahweh's message with three choices to David?
questions.explanation: Yahweh's word came to the prophet Gad, David's seer, who went to David and told him the three choices.

questions.text: How long would the pestilence in the land last, according to Gad's offer?
questions.explanation: Gad offered seven years of famine, three months of fleeing before foes, or three days' pestilence in the land.

questions.text: Why did David prefer to fall into Yahweh's hand?
questions.explanation: David said, "Let us fall now into Yahweh's hand; for his mercies are great. Let me not fall into man's hand."

answers.text: Because his own army was too weak
Because the famine would be too long

questions.text: Where was Yahweh's angel when Yahweh said, "It is enough"?
questions.explanation: When Yahweh told the angel to withdraw his hand, Yahweh's angel was by the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite.

answers.text: By the well of Bethlehem near the gate
On the walls of the stronghold of Zion
By the threshing floor of Araunah the Jebusite
By the brook Kidron outside Jerusalem

questions.text: For what price did David buy the threshing floor and the oxen?
questions.explanation: David refused to offer what cost him nothing and bought the threshing floor and the oxen for fifty shekels of silver.
